title: Quick French Beans Pie
description: A buttery, flaky pie filled with low-sodium refried beans, quick to make and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and lightly grease a 9-inch pie dish.
Spread a thin layer of olive oil over the surface of the pre-made pie crust and place it in the greased dish.
In a bowl, mix the refried beans, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper until evenly combined.
Spoon the bean mixture into the prepared crust, smoothing the top with a spatula.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese evenly over the bean layer.
Sprinkle chopped green onions and fresh basil on top of the cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the crust is golden and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Allow the pie to rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
